routing_result.work: The product owner names a piece of work. Agents shape it into a slice that one person can test, make its plan and write its eval. The product owner confirms each part as it is made.

unmatched_domains.name: software delivery planning
unmatched_domains.why: The field the work serves is software delivery: the product owner works on business intents, slices, plans, work items and evals before a build. None of the ten shelves (analytics, collaboration, content-management, ecommerce, experience, marketing, notifications, payments, personalization, user-management) has a trigger for that field; collaboration's trigger is several people co-editing one object, which is not the job here (one product owner confirms what agents shape). The product model already holds this field as dom-software-delivery-planning, written when an earlier placement was also unmatched.

routing_result.note: The feature this run takes in (story #898: the build is given the business intent, never the eval) does the same job in the same field, so it is unmatched on the shelves too; in the product model it sits under cap-shape-eval of dom-software-delivery-planning.
